scene: Home entryway on a rainy morning. The window at screen-left shows soft rain streaks; the front door stays closed. Two couch cushions lean against the wall at center. Dad stands screen-left; Child stands screen-right. Locked 16:9 medium two-shot with both faces visible.

emotion.baseline: Calm, warm and regulated baseline. Both speak at a normal family volume with small, natural facial movements and gestures.
emotion.allowed_shift: Brief shared disappointment turns into playful planning; both end energized and agreeing on the new plan.
emotion.forbidden: No exaggerated surprise, wide-eyed shock, bouncing, raised voices, impatience, blaming or teasing. Any disappointment, worry or sadness stays mild and brief, and the adult helps things stay steady.

clips.start: Dad stands by the rain-streaked window; Child stands facing him with empty hands; the two cushions lean against the wall.
clips.action: Dad tips his head toward the window with a sorry smile. Child looks at the rain and asks his checking question; Dad wiggles his fingers downward like rain while explaining the wet slides.
clips.end: Both look away from the window; Child glances at the cushions by the wall.

clips.start: Both look away from the window; Child glances at the cushions by the wall.
clips.action: Child points at the cushions, then mimes a small slide motion with his hand. Dad crosses his arms with an interested face and asks how it works; Child arranges his palms like little hills and swoops one hand down like a slide.
clips.end: Both look at the two cushions leaning against the wall.

clips.start: Both look at the two cushions leaning against the wall.
clips.action: Dad claps once softly and points toward the living room for the after-lunch plan. Child raises both fists in a small determined cheer; Dad chuckles and ruffles the air above Child's head.
clips.end: Both stand smiling by the entryway; the rain keeps streaking the window; the cushions wait against the wall.
